entities.summary: Southern Tour, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Reform Era and Rise of China (1992–2012). Preceded by Economic Miracle and WTO Accession and Tiananmen Square massacre — military crushes pro-democracy protests. Their legacy influenced China joins the World Trade Organization and Beijing hosts the Olympic Games, showcasing China's rise.
